objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Tall, slender vertical pole, towering dramatically over surrounding structures.
Tapered design (thicker at base, thinner at top) or uniform diameter.
Finial (decorative ball, eagle, or spear) at apex.
Functional_Components: Halyard (rope) runs through pulley at top for raising/lowering flag.
Cleat at base for securing halyard.
Flag flies from halyard, fully extended in wind.
Material_and_Context: Aluminum (silver, anodized), fiberglass (white), or wood (natural grain).
Surface is smooth with metallic or painted finish.
Base is embedded in concrete or mounted on pedestal.

objects.taxonomy_description: Croissant（牛角包）是一种具有特定几何形态和表面纹理的烘焙面点，不属于生物分类范畴。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 呈现标志性的新月形或角状弯曲结构，两端尖细，中间膨大。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面纹理: 表面具有清晰可见的层状剥离结构（千层酥皮），显示出面团折叠烘烤后的分层特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.色泽特征: 整体呈均匀的金黄色至深褐色，表面通常带有烘烤产生的光泽，无生物表皮特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.结构完整性: 为单一连续的固体食物单元，无头尾、四肢或器官等生物解剖结构。

objects.taxonomy_description: Fleet equine mammal measuring 120-150 cm at withers with distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern. Stripes unique to each individual, extending across body, legs, and mane. Head elongated with large dark eyes and mobile ears. Neck arched with erect bristly mane. Body robust and muscular. Legs long and slender terminating in single dark hooves. Tail long with black tufted hair. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse body hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. African equine with herd behavior. Stripes serve as camouflage and fly deterrent.

Head_and_Face: Elongated head with large dark eyes and mobile ears.
Erect bristly mane on arched neck.
Body_and_Plumage: Fleet equine body with tall, athletic proportions at the withers.
Distinctive black-and-white striped coat pattern unique to each individual.
Stripes extend across body, legs, and mane.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Long slender legs terminating in single dark hooves.
Long tail with black tufted hair.
